title: Sign up with email
criteria: A visitor can create an account with email and password
A duplicate email is refused with a clear message

title: Sign in and sign out
criteria: A registered user can sign in and stays signed in across reloads
Signing out ends the session on this device

title: Reset a forgotten password
criteria: A reset link is sent to the registered email
The link expires after one use

title: Create a note
criteria: A signed-in user can create a note with a title and body
The note is saved and appears at the top of their list

title: Edit and delete a note
criteria: Edits are saved without losing earlier content
Deleting a note asks for confirmation and removes it from the list

title: Search notes
criteria: Search matches words in titles and bodies
Results update as the user types

title: Tag notes
criteria: A note can carry several tags
The list can be filtered by tag

title: Share a note by link
criteria: The owner can create a read-only link to a note
Revoking the link makes it stop working

title: Invite a collaborator
criteria: The owner can invite another user by email to edit a note
The collaborator's edits are visible to the owner

title: Export all notes
criteria: A user can download all their notes as a single file
The export includes titles, bodies, tags and dates
